findings.evidence: `pkg/statistics/handle/initstats/load_stats.go`: `LoadStats` starts `runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)` goroutines; each runs `ls.dealFunc(...)` concurrently. `pkg/statistics/handle/bootstrap.go`: concurrency branches use `initstats.NewWorker(rc.Next, ...)` for meta/hist/topn/buckets; the deal funcs call `cache.Put(...)`. `pkg/statistics/handle/cache/statscacheinner.go`: when `Performance.EnableStatsCacheMemQuota` is false, `NewStatsCache()` picks `mapcache.NewMapCache()`. `pkg/statistics/handle/cache/internal/mapcache/map_cache.go`: `MapCache` is backed by a plain Go `map` and `Put` mutates it without synchronization.
findings.fix: Make the non-quota stats cache implementation safe under concurrent `Put`/`Del` (e.g., add a mutex or switch to a concurrent map), or force init-stats to run with concurrency=1 / the non-concurrent path when `Performance.EnableStatsCacheMemQuota` is false, or always use the LFU stats cache implementation for init-stats regardless of the mem-quota toggle.
findings.impact: TiDB can crash (panic) during bootstrap/init-stats for deployments that set `performance.enable-stats-cache-mem-quota=false` while concurrent init-stats is enabled (this PR also defaults concurrent init-stats to true), turning a previously working config into a startup failure.
findings.later_fix_evidence: On `upstream/master`, `pkg/statistics/handle/cache/statscacheinner.go` still selects `mapcache.NewMapCache()` when mem-quota is disabled and `pkg/statistics/handle/cache/internal/mapcache/map_cache.go` remains an unsynchronized map. Concurrent init-stats is now always enabled after #60408, and the init-stats worker (`pkg/statistics/handle/initstats/load_stats_page.go`) still spawns multiple goroutines, so the same `concurrent map writes` panic risk remains for `enable-stats-cache-mem-quota=false`.
findings.verify: Start TiDB with `enable-stats-cache-mem-quota=false` and concurrent init-stats enabled (or on newer code where it’s always enabled); ensure bootstrap/init-stats completes without `fatal error: concurrent map writes` and logs indicate stats init completion.
findings.what: `performance.enable-stats-cache-mem-quota=false` selects a map-backed stats cache that is not safe for concurrent writes; with `performance.concurrently-init-stats=true` (default in this commit), init-stats spawns multiple goroutines that call `StatsCache.Put` concurrently, which can trigger `fatal error: concurrent map writes` during bootstrap.

subject: statistics: concurrency init stats (#51403)
summary: One Blocker remains on `upstream/master`: concurrent init-stats can panic with `enable-stats-cache-mem-quota=false` due to unsynchronized map-backed stats cache writes; this PR’s default enables concurrent init-stats, and later history makes concurrency always-on without addressing the mapcache thread-safety gap.
